claim_scope.depth_resolution: Five sampled processing stages, not a dense layer scan or a universal monotonicity claim.
claim_scope.literary_usefulness: Blinded human judgments remain a separate pending study. No human responses or AI-generated ratings are inferred here.
claim_scope.missing_or_constant: Incomplete execution prevents confirmation output. Constant or undefined RDMs remain explicit; never remove unfavorable seeds or poems.
primary: Qwen FP32 mean token-shuffle early stability and early-to-final-raw decrease
Qwen-Muse FP32 final-raw mean RSA increase after token shuffling
claim_scope.secondary: Gemma depth criterion and both Gemma-containing pair criteria are separately prespecified; every model, state, readout, intervention, precision and seed remains in the output.
claim_scope.sensitivity: All 24 omissions x five seeds for six primary/prespecified-secondary token/mean contrasts; positivity across every omission separately qualifies sensitivity, without replacing full-cohort criteria.
claim_scope.thresholds: Pragmatic descriptive effect sizes chosen after v3 and before v4 inference. Not significance tests, power calculations, public preregistration, semantic scores or proof of mechanism.

execution.accounting: Preserve all canonical ledgers and failed reservations. Conservative accounting is not a provider invoice or billing cap. Storage and transfer remain separate.
execution.approval_text: The owner said "go ahead and spend more money" and then "Just keep on going" after the proposed $15 additional reservation and recommended $40 total ceiling were presented. Proceed with that bounded three-model confirmation: one $5 reservation per model, at most $33.00875 cumulative reserved accounting. The recommended $40 ceiling is accepted in context; no unlimited or further automatic runs are authorized.
execution.pilot: First two selected poems, all 16 unique inputs in both precisions, in the same bounded worker. Measure both dtypes before scaling; retain incomplete work and do not retry automatically.
execution.scope: One three-family confirmation attempt; unused budget does not schedule further work.

population.author: Philip Sidney
population.identity: number is position in this 1591 edition, not a claimed canonical 1598 sonnet number
population.independence: New to this study; training exposure unknown. One related sonnet cycle/author/edition, not 24 independent authors or traditions.
population.new_population_limits: Author, historical spelling, source edition and poem population change together; the design does not identify which explains a transfer failure.
population.selection: 24 of all 107 fourteen-line main-sequence sonnets, selected by SHA256('20261018\n'+stable edition-position ID); ten variable-verse works excluded before selection. No response-based replacement.

precision.arithmetic_gate: Original AND perturbed BF16/FP32 RDM rho>=.95 and max median precision RDM delta<=.10 times FP32 intervention delta. A failure prevents describing BF16 as an adequate proxy, but is not substituted for the primary FP32 result.
precision.requirements: Original and all fifteen perturbations run in both dtypes with identical token IDs, right-padding masks and position IDs; no TF32 or autocast; evaluation/inference mode; actual dtypes recorded and validated.
precision.semantics: Load the same pinned BF16 checkpoint values, then promote arithmetic to FP32. This does not recover higher-precision source weights.

privacy: Private repository and private GCS only. No public release authorized.
question: Which depth-dependent relationships survive a new poem population, repeated order interventions, and FP32 execution of both original and perturbed inputs?

randomization.cross_model: Word/line controls use identical surface texts across families. Token controls preserve each tokenizer's own IDs: the same seed is not an identical perturbed surface text across models.
randomization.inference_unit: Five seeds are repeated interventions on the same 24 poems; 276 pairwise distances and leave-one-poem-out subsets are dependent observations.
randomization.line_control: Shuffle lines except final two; preserve complete line strings, entire lexical inventory and final couplet. Retokenize; token differences remain measured confounds.
randomization.method: SHA256 domain-separated record identity, intervention and seed initializes Python random.Random; all seeds frozen before inference. Preserve duplicate/no-op realizations, never resample for effect.
randomization.token_control: Shuffle eligible lexical token pieces within original line slots; preserve special/separator tokens and final lexical token of each line. Exactly preserve token IDs multiset and forward length; not grammatical word order. The last eligible piece per line also stays fixed, as in v3.
randomization.word_control: Shuffle lexical word strings inside each line, preserving punctuation slots, character count, word inventory and each final word. Retokenize; token-count differences are measured.
